description: Passive security check of one public URL: one ordinary page load plus public DNS. Grades HTTPS, HSTS, Content-Security-Policy, clickjacking protection, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, version-leaking headers, cookie flags, SPF, DMARC, DKIM, CAA and DNSSEC from A to F, with a fix for each issue. Not a vulnerability scan.

url.description: Public web page to check, e.g. example.com or https://example.com/pricing

name: security_headers_check
title: Security headers check (passive)
